Hi Ava — great to meet today. Quick recap + the Mutual Action Plan (attached).

Call recap (30 min):
- Primary goal: 6-week evaluation to validate latency and cost improvements for your embeddings pipeline.
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency < 120ms, 35% reduction in token cost vs current infra, and no change in model output quality for reranking flow.
- Scope: data privacy constraints (PII redaction), on-prem connector for sensitive workloads, and short-term hosted proof-of-concept for dev team.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Confirm MAP owners + tentative completion dates (I suggested owners in the attached MAP).
2) Kickoff technical sync with Marcus from infra (we can do next Tue/Wed).
3) Exchange SOC2 evidence if security review will be required.

I'm attaching: Finvero_MAP_v1.pdf (mutual action plan) and Finvero_Eval_Timeline.xlsx (proposed milestones). Can you confirm who on your side will own each line item and whether the June 21 start date still looks realistic?

If priorities shifted, say so and we can propose alternate timelines — no pressure.
